generation.label: hook
generation.narration: That drip under your tailpipe — normal, or worth worrying about?
generation.prompt: Close-up on the chrome tip of a car's exhaust tailpipe, a single water droplet forming, hanging, and falling in soft cold-morning backlight; shallow depth of field; visible engine vibration in the pipe; steam breath drifting past frame.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: the droplet mid-fall, strongest possible first frame, unbranded, wordless

generation.label: symptom
generation.narration: On a cold Cleveland morning, water dripping from your exhaust is common.
generation.prompt: Wider shot, a car idling in a driveway on a frosty Cleveland morning, visible exhaust vapor plume drifting from the tailpipe into cold air, small puddle of drips forming and spreading on the pavement below.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: continue directly from beat 1's tailpipe, same object state

generation.label: explanation
generation.narration: Burning fuel creates water vapor. In a cool muffler, it condenses and drips out as your engine warms up.
generation.prompt: Object-only technical cutaway of a muffler's interior cross-section, animated water-vapor particles condensing on the cool metal walls into droplets that run down and out the pipe; clean diagrammatic lighting, slow camera push-in; no text or labels rendered in-scene.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts, on-screen text, logos, watermarks
generation.openingFrame: establish the cutaway clearly at a glance

generation.label: consequence_proof
generation.narration: But sweet-smelling white smoke that keeps going after warm-up can point to a coolant leak into the engine.
generation.prompt: Close-up on the same tailpipe now emitting a thicker, continuous white vapor plume that does not taper off as the engine idles longer, backlit to show density and persistence, contrast against beat 2's thinner intermittent puff.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: continue from beat 2's tailpipe, now denser plume

generation.label: safe_action
generation.narration: One clue is not a diagnosis — worth checking your coolant level early, before it becomes a bigger repair.
generation.prompt: A shop inspection light on a stand sweeps its beam across a translucent coolant reservoir tank on a workbench, fluid level line clearly visible against min/max markings, cap resting loosely beside it — no hands present, the light beam itself is the only motion besides a slow rack-focus.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: reservoir clearly readable at a glance, light beam entering frame

generation.label: branded_cta
generation.narration: Stop by and we'll take a look — Nick's Tire and Auto, on Euclid Avenue.
generation.prompt: Exterior establishing shot of Nick's Tire & Auto's shop bay, tire stack in foreground, late-afternoon light, logo signage visible and legible; camera holds steady for a clean end-card composite.
generation.negativePrompt: human face, person, hands, gloves, arms, talking head, low-res, blurry, extra fingers, plastic glow, oversaturated AI look, warped engine parts
generation.openingFrame: shop bay clearly readable, settles for a seamless hold into the freeze
